title: Order Tracking
content: Customers can track their orders from the My Orders section. Each order displays its current status and tracking information.

title: Return Policy
content: Customers can request a return within 7 days of receiving an eligible product. Products must be unused and in their original packaging.

title: Payment Methods
content: Click2Cart supports online payments through Stripe. Customers can complete their payments securely during checkout.

title: Password Reset
content: Customers who forget their password can use the Forgot Password option on the login page to reset their password.
